description: Chintu aur Mithu ke saath samundar ki gehraiyon mein shapes seekhein. Bacche pyaare samudri jeevon ke saath circle, square aur triangle pehchanna seekhenge.
learning: Teaching toddlers basic shapes (circle, square, triangle) through underwater marine life themes.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: A cute orange baby elephant with a blue scarf and a tiny green parrot with a red cap swimming underwater in a bright blue ocean.

scenes.text:
चिट्टू हाथी देखो आया,
Chintu Elephant loves to play.
scenes.image_prompt: A small round orange baby elephant swimming underwater with a happy expression.

scenes.text:
मिथु तोता साथ है लाया,
Mithu Parrot leads the way.
scenes.image_prompt: A tiny green parrot with a yellow tummy and red cap flying/swimming through bubbles.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu high-fiving underwater near a sparkling coral reef.

scenes.text:
देखो जेलीफिश गोल है प्यारी,
See the jelly, round and bright.
scenes.image_prompt: A cute round pink jellyfish glowing softly in the dark blue ocean.

scenes.text:
लाल रंग में न्यारी न्यारी,
Red color shines in the light.
scenes.image_prompt: The red jellyfish wiggling happily near some seaweed.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu the elephant pointing at the round jellyfish with his trunk.

scenes.text:
एक बक्सा है वर्गाकार,
Square box, a secret treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: A small square wooden chest resting on the sandy ocean floor.

scenes.text:
खजाना भरा है अपार,
Square treasure is a pleasure.
scenes.image_prompt: The treasure chest opening to reveal shiny gold-colored bubbles.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the parrot perched on the corner of the square chest.

scenes.text:
त्रिकोण जैसी मछली देखो,
Triangle fish swims so fast.
scenes.image_prompt: A cute bright yellow triangular shaped fish darting through the water.

scenes.text:
पीले पंख, मजे में देखो,
Three corners, made to last.
scenes.image_prompt: Two triangular fish swimming together in a line.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu waving goodbye to the school of triangular fish.

scenes.text:
सीप का आकार भी गोल,
Shell is round like a ball.
scenes.image_prompt: A perfect round white seashell sitting on a rock.

scenes.text:
सबके हैं अपने मोल,
Round shapes are for us all.
scenes.image_prompt: Many different round colorful shells scattered on the ocean sand.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: A wide shot of the ocean floor with Chintu and Mithu smiling at the camera.

scenes.text:
चौकोर पत्थर रेत में,
Square rock in the sand.
scenes.image_prompt: A flat square-shaped rock resting near a starfish.

scenes.text:
छिप गए सब खेल में,
We hold hands across the land.
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu playing near the square rock.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Chintu's big sparkly eyes reflecting the ocean light.

scenes.text:
त्रिकोण काँटे स्टारफिश के,
Starfish has points so neat.
scenes.image_prompt: A cute orange starfish showing off its triangular-shaped arms.

scenes.text:
गिनो चलो, ये हैं एक के,
Count the points for a treat.
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu counting the arms of the starfish with his beak.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: The starfish doing a little dance for Chintu and Mithu.

scenes.text:
आकार सारे हमने जाने,
Shapes we learned, one by one.
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu holding a circle, a square, and a triangle shaped bubble.

scenes.text:
समुद्र के हैं ये ठिकाने,
Under sea fun has begun.
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu swimming upwards towards the surface.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
scenes.image_prompt: Sunlight rays coming down through the water surface.

scenes.text:
बाय बाय मछली रानी,
Bye bye little fish friends.
scenes.image_prompt: School of colorful fish waving their fins.

scenes.text:
खत्म हुई ये कहानी,
Story time now ends.
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu swimming away into the distance.

scenes.text:
गोल गोल है नीला सागर,
Round and round the blue sea shore.
